summary: The CI evidence gate keeps judging a pull request's head tree when main changed only the signing keys, the author list or the evidence log's key after the branch point: those are read at the accepted base when a note is judged, so a key rotation on main no longer voids every head signature made before it

replay.detail: No record, signature or storage format changes.

rules.detail: branch_point_verdict ignores main-side changes to .st/evidence-keys, .st/evidence-authors.json and .st/evidence-log-key (BASE_READ). Every other protected file still makes the run fall back to the merge tree, and the branch's own edits to these files still count as protected changes. Trust is unchanged: keys, authors and the log key are read from the base, so a note the change distrusts is refused.

compatibility.detail: st-test asks the base's branch_point_verdict, so it picks the rule up from main once this merges.
